overview.en:
Search, read and organize Drive files through Google’s official Drive API with your Google account.

Locate files and review their contents in the connected workspace. Keep file identity and access context explicit when preparing a summary or organization plan.

Select Connect in the plugin details. One Google account connection is shared by every installed Google plugin; granted permissions still limit each service.
overview.zh-CN:
通过 Google 官方 Drive API 与已连接的 Google 账号检索、阅读与整理云端硬盘文件。

在已连接工作区中定位文件并查看内容，准备摘要或整理方案时明确文件身份与访问范围。

在插件详情中选择“连接”。所有已安装的 Google 插件共用一次 Google 账号连接，各服务仍受已授予权限的限制。

starterPrompts.en: Find the files for this project and summarize what each contains.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 查找这个项目的文件，并汇总各文件内容。

starterPrompts.en: Compare these two documents and list the substantive differences.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 比较这两份文档，列出实质性差异。

starterPrompts.en: Prepare a file organization plan for this project without moving files yet.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 为这个项目准备文件整理方案，先不要移动文件。

descriptions.en: Use Google Drive in Ghast. Search, read and organize Drive files through Google’s official Drive API with your Google account. 通过 Google 官方 Drive API 与已连接的 Google 账号检索、阅读与整理云端硬盘文件。
